title: Titanium Neuro Guidewire
alloyReason: Nitinol (ASTM F2063) is specified for this interventional self-expanding application where 55-60Ni wt% delivers superelastic recovery up to 8% at body temp. Af temperature is set 10-15C below operating temp for complete austenitic transformation. This rationale is driven by neurovascular micro-guidewire core (nitinol) and specific design requirements.
process: CNC swiss turning for interventional geometry
Ultrasonic clean Class 10k with Class 6g gauge
surfaceTreatment: Electropolishing + passivation per ASTM F86 (20-30% HNO3, 30min @50C) achieving Ra <0.2um for implant-grade finish — tailored for neurovascular microguidewire core application
commonFailures: Galvanic pitting at Ti-316L interface in vivo - eliminated by ceramic Al2O3 coating on mating surfaces — critical for neurovascular microguidewire core performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Neuro Guidewire suitable for Neurovascular micro-guidewire core (Nitinol)?
faq.a: Titanium Neuro Guidewire uses Nitinol because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address interventional operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Neuro Guidewire?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Neuro Guidewire is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for neurovascular microguidewire core requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Neuro Guidewire require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. neurovascular microguidewire core components require Electropolishing + passivation per ASTM F86 (20-30% HNO3, 30min @50C) achieving Ra <0.2um for implant-grade finish — tailored for neurovascular microguidewire core application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Neuro Guidewire shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Neuro Guidewire includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet neurovascular microguidewire core specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Guidewire / Brain wire interventional components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
